# prime-inplace

prime-rs: Inplace component (port of PrimeNG)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/inplace) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-inplace) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/inplace.md)

Inplace — port of `p-inplace` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

An area that replaces the "display" view with the "content" on click (or `Enter`). The content receives a close
function (analogue of `closeCallback`). The state is an optional two-way signal `active`.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_inplace::Inplace;

let html = view! {
    <Inplace
        display=ViewFn::from(|| view! { <span>"View"</span> })
        content=Callback::new(|_close| view! { <p>"Body"</p> }.into_any())
    />
}
.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-inplace-display") && html.contains("View") && !html.contains("Body"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-inplace = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["inplace"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
